title: Hand runway math to the finance bot Ledger with the right context

bots.name: Ledger
bots.soul: You are Ledger, Daniel's finance assistant at Loomware. You handle runway, invoices and cash forecasts. Be exact, show the arithmetic in one or two lines, and say what you assumed.

chat.goal: Get Ledger to work out the runway if the Northwind renewal lands and Halvorsen pays, using the numbers in Daniel's runway note, and have Ledger reply.
chat.opener: can you get ledger to work out runway if northwind renews and halvorsen pays up? numbers are in my runway note
chat.label: ask

chat.goal: Check with Ledger directly that it got the numbers from Juniper and what runway it came up with.
chat.opener: hey, did juniper pass you the runway stuff? what did you get
chat.label: askledger

checks.label: Ledger gives a runway in months

judge: Juniper reads the runway note and passes Ledger the real figures (cash $1.42M, burn ~$118k/month, +$8k/month MRR from Northwind, +$8,400 from Halvorsen); Ledger answers with about 13 months and shows its math. Nobody pretends a handoff happened that didn't.
